design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (d2_contract_pricing_claims_and_rebates): contract price claim on a discontinued item's substitute, Corbett Category Contract.

1. Why this is a good test. Renee Holcomb (Glenmore Corrugated Packaging, Inc.) asks only to file a contract price claim on the INV-2260930 line that billed 140 boxes of AB-21795 at 72.5700. To give her the right figures the agent must read four prerequisite-carrying rules in turn: the claim "is fixed only after the records carry the substitute's protection line"; the protected price "is not set until the records carry the close-out line of the discontinued item it replaces"; the close-out price "is fixed only after the price claim most recently filed on that item carries a decision". The records show AB-21795 filled the AB-21740 backorder BO-214452 on 2026-08-24 (the discontinuation), no protection line, no close-out line, and claim PCL-210356 on AB-21740 pending since 2026-10-13. Four writes in topological order, each with its own multi-factor figure (20 factors), reading order shipments, backorders and returns, the credit ledger (invoices, tax, discounts, payments) and StockSmart/VendPoint holdings.

2. Scope (Principle C). Task 0 already claims the rebate side (final check, termination forfeiture, return clawback). Task 1 claims the remaining four policies and tools: pricing_ext_substitute_claim (root, owner=user, file_contract_price_claim_992a36b2), pricing_ext_substitute_protection (protect_substitute_price_656c6d72), pricing_ext_discontinued_closeout (close_out_discontinued_item_dd8bcab8), pricing_ext_open_claim_decision (decide_pending_price_claim_4f6327a3). Together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies with disjoint scopes.

3. Draw. draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 3, factor_counts [6, 5, 4, 5]; assigned decision 6, protection 5, claim 5, close-out 4.

4. Problem-tree card (chain claim -> protection -> close-out -> decision; all value_input).
 E1 claim -> protection: gate prot_price, form state, sentence "A claim on a substitute line billed during its protection is fixed only after the records carry the substitute's protection line." (affirmative: a figure fixed only after). Only protect_substitute_price_656c6d72 writes a line with the change reason of a discontinued item's substitute. False at the opening: no pricing_items row for AB-21795 at all although its fill (2026-08-24) and shipment (2026-09-16) are on record. Deletion sensitivity: without step 19 the claim is out of any protection window -> 0.00 instead of 1,732.79.
 E2 protection -> close-out: gate ending, form state, sentence "The substitute's protected price is not set until the records carry the close-out line of the discontinued item it replaces." (negated: a price is not set until). Only close_out_discontinued_item_dd8bcab8 writes removal lines. False at the opening: AB-21740's latest line is the 2026-08-03 escalation; no removal. Deletion sensitivity: without step 17 there is no ending price -> 0.0000 instead of 59.5405.
 E3 close-out -> decision: gate ref_price, form state, sentence "The close-out price of a discontinued item is fixed only after the price claim most recently filed on that item carries a decision." (round 2: quantifier aligned with the decision's single-claim scope) Only decide_pending_price_claim_4f6327a3 writes decision lines. False at the opening: PCL-210356 (AB-21740, filed 2026-10-13, outcome pending, inside the 7-business-day decision period) has no decision line. Deletion sensitivity: without step 15 the close-out starts from the escalation's prior price 61.2000 (recent-escalation tier) -> 59.3640 instead of 59.6156.
 Topological order: decision (15) -> close-out (17) -> protection (19) -> claim (21). A chain, so no two writes may be reordered. owner=user problem: the claim filing (base: "A customer billed above the price ... may file a contract price claim"). Every resolving write is synchronous; no real-world wait.

5. Base-invariant card. pricing_claim_filed: pricing_evt_price_claim gates inside_claim_window (time: anchor credit_transactions.txn_date of INV-2260930 = 2026-09-30, 90 calendar days counted from the day after, inclusive -> last day 2026-12-29; filing on 2026-10-16 is day 16; a filing on 2026-12-30 would be refused) and one_claim_per_line (no claim on INV-2260930 / AB-21795 exists; PCL-210356 is on INV-2260831 / AB-21740). pricing_claim_decided: no structured gate (policy_scope). pricing_item_removed: pricing_evt_contract_items and pricing_price_basis, no gate (policy_scope). pricing_item_added: live_agreement_only (agreement status active) inherited; quote_still_valid retired by the protection's overwrite of the quote sentence (a protection line involves no quote). Overwrites: decision retires the base escalation sentence for the one escalation it reviews (every other escalation keeps it verbatim); close-out retires the removal-notice sentence for a discontinued item (others keep it); protection retires the substitute-billing sentence and the quote sentence for the one substitute it protects (others keep them); the claim retires the claim-amount sentence for its own claim (others keep it). No two policies retire the same clause.

6. Business-object card. Discontinued item AB-21740: latest backorder BO-214452 (SO-2140115 line 2, 100 boxes, booked 63.6480) filled with AB-21795 on 2026-08-24 at the lower-of price 63.6480 (order charter). Pending claim PCL-210356: 600 boxes of AB-21740 shipped 2026-08-05 at the escalated 63.6480 (escalation effective 2026-08-03, notice 2026-07-02). Claimed line: SO-2143380 line 1, 140 boxes of AB-21795 at 72.5700, shipped 2026-09-16, on INV-2260930. Excluded: PCL-209915 (FS-20118, filed billed 0.3950 against a claimed 0.3820, decided denied in March) from the pending set and from the repeat count; RMA-211846 (an April AB-21740 line) from the claim quantity; the backorder fill from the substitute's own regular price.

7. Factor cards (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure).
 Decision (6): increase_measure_basis [method; list 84.00 -> 85.70 (+2.0238 percent) rose by less than cost 44.10 -> 46.40 (+5.2154) -> list rise; baseline 62.6688]; shipped_volume_reduction [order: 810 units in 12 months -> 0.5 points; 61.7654]; commitment_reduction [credit: 105,665.10 / 75,000.00 = 1.41 -> 0.25; 61.6124]; notice_margin_reduction [32 - 30 = 2 extra days -> 0.5; 61.7654]; contract_breadth_reduction [28 items -> 0.25; 61.6124]; escalation_load_reduction [7 escalations in 12 months -> 0.1; 61.5206]. Whole baseline 63.6480 (the base escalation: cost increase capped at 4.0). Method shapes: list-rise measure, zero, cost-rise measure (distinguishing input: list +2.02 / cost +5.22 gives 2.02 vs 0 vs 5.22).
 Close-out (4): closeout_reference_basis [method; decision of step 15 on/after the escalation -> start from 61.4594; tiers: decided price / escalation's prior price when the escalation took effect within 30 days of the discontinuation / latest price — distinct inputs; baseline 61.7386]; discontinued_usage_concession [810 units -> 1.0 percent; 60.2302]; stranded_order_concession [100 units filled with the substitute -> 1.5; 60.5375]; substitute_gap_concession [72.57 vs 63.648 = +14.02 percent -> 0.5; 59.9229]. Whole baseline 63.6480.
 Protection (5): substitute_start_basis [method; 72.57 is at least 15 percent above the ending 59.6156 -> ending + 0.1 x gap = 60.91104; tiers: substitute's own price when lower / shared gap / ending price; baseline 58.2742]; substitute_adoption_concession [240 units shipped or filled in 3 months -> 1.0; 60.1497]; kept_program_concession [multi-source, cross-difficulty vmi+vending: StockSmart VMI-21177 active, VendPoint VP-217730 removed -> 0.5; 59.8451]; prompt_payment_concession [12 discounts in 12 months -> 0.5; 59.8451]; agreement_tenure_concession [21 months since proposal -> 0.25; 59.6928]. Whole baseline 59.6156.
 Claim (5): returned_quantity_basis [method; RMA-213377 received 20 -> 120; baseline 2,021.59]; invoice_settlement_multiplier [method; tax 949.74 and discount 88.45 on merchandise 13,099.80 -> 1 + 0.0725 - 88.45 / 13,099.80 = 1.065748, the discount being earned on merchandise only (credit_evt_cash_discount); four tiers (tax and discount / tax / discount / neither); baseline 1,629.99]; repeat_overbilling_credit [1 earlier claim on the item it replaced -> 2.5 percent; 1,693.70]; paid_invoice_credit [covered, paid 7 days ago -> 0.75; 1,721.06]; prompt_claim_credit [16 days after the invoice date -> 1.0; 1,717.16]. Whole baseline 1,824.13.
 Every factor sits off its fall-through; tiers rest on ledgers, dates and holdings, never on a stamp.

8. initial_state rows. customers (identity: C-217455, phone 5133364872); credit_accounts (Net 30 Preferred, active, receivable 0.00); credit_transactions (12 monthly invoices Oct-2025..Sep-2026 taxed 7.25 percent, each paid inside 10 days and settled in full; the prompt-payment discount is the base 1 percent of merchandise on the four invoices dated before the live agreement's current term (2026-02-01) and, under the credit catch-up rule, 1 percent x 0.75 (Category Contract share) x 1 (no finance charges) on merchandise less applied return credits on the eight invoices inside it — e.g. INV-2260930 88.45 on 13,099.80 - 1,306.26; two return credit memos applied to the invoices that billed the items); ship_to_accounts (Route Delivery: restocking 10 percent, pickup free, substitution offer 10 days); order_lines (five AB-21740 shipments, the AB-21740 booking/backorder/substitute fill, the AB-21795 booking/shipment); order_returns (RMA-211846 defective on an April AB-21740 line, RMA-213377 for 20 of the claimed line); pricing_agreements (Category Contract, second term from 2026-02-01, active); pricing_items (28 contract items, 7 escalations effective 2026-08-03); pricing_claims (PCL-209915 filed and denied, PCL-210356 pending); vmi_programs (active StockSmart Monthly Service VMI-21177, live 2024-05-24, 14 business days after enrollment, inside the tier's 15) with vmi_bins (76 bins) and vmi_activity (one scheduled visit a month 2025-10..2026-09 replenishing three contract items at their contract prices, billed about 2,092-2,117 a month, above the 2,000.00 minimum, so no fee is due); vending_machines (removed Locker 12, installed 2023-02-24, 8 business days after the request, inside its 10-day lead). Automatic-clause check: the renewal window opens 2026-12-02 (future); the 2026-08-03 escalations respect the lock (2026-08-01) and the notice (30 days); no rebate (Category not rebate-eligible); the credit account has no open or past-due balance; the AB-21740 backorder is fully relieved (open_backorder_value 0.00); the pending claim decision, the close-out and the protection the seed makes due are all carried by this task. No cache trap.

9. Persona. Renee is friendly, precise and has the invoice in front of her; she volunteers only the invoice, item, quantity and price (all on the shipment and invoice rows) and her belief that the line was billed above what the agreement allows; identity, agreement number and the returned boxes are given only when asked; she cannot speak to older claims or Corbett's records and defers to them. She runs the filing herself with exactly the figures handed over and closes on the claim reference. She never mentions the pending claim, the escalation, a close-out or a protection line.

10. Standard solution (handling-time recomputation executed with the gate's evaluator, t1_vals.py): step 15 decision 61.4594 (referred: 600 x 2.1886 = 1,313.16 > 500.00); step 17 close-out 59.6156 effective 2026-08-24; step 19 protection 59.5405 effective 2026-08-24 (prior 72.5700); step 21 claim on INV-2260930 / AB-21795, quantity 120, billed 72.5700, contract 59.5405, amount 1,732.79.

11. Easy mistakes. Claiming 140 boxes (the 20 returned were credited); claiming against AB-21740's escalated 63.6480 or its original 61.2000; protecting the substitute without closing out the discontinued item; closing out before the pending claim is decided (59.3640); approving PCL-210356 (it exceeds the 500.00 desk authority, and the decision records no credit); counting PCL-209915 as an earlier claim on the item; ignoring the invoice's tax and discount.

12. Policy/GT closure. decision -> decide_pending_price_claim_4f6327a3 -> step 15 contract_unit_price 61.4594; close-out -> close_out_discontinued_item_dd8bcab8 -> step 17 contract_unit_price 59.6156; protection -> protect_substitute_price_656c6d72 -> step 19 contract_unit_price 59.5405; claim -> file_contract_price_claim_992a36b2 -> step 21 claim_amount 1,732.79. charter_scope = required_documents (root first); task_tools in order of first call.

13. Draft recomputation from visible context (compute/GT masked): the three prerequisite sentences, the records returned by the finders and the published ladders force the same order and the same four figures.

14. Gate runs. Per task: EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY, SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE, GROUNDING, SCOPE OK. Revisions: (r1) one_claim_per_line evidence lacked pricing_claims sku/event_type paths -> added; (r2) close-out and protection history floor failed (only LATEST reads) -> the decided-price tier counts decision lines and the ending price requires a counted close-out line; (r3) docstrings rid of ordering words; (r4) other contract items' prior prices re-derived from the Category Contract category schedule, one contract price lowered below it.

 Round 2 rework (audit revision_1): T1-1/CG-1 the decision now declares an overwrite of pricing_price_basis s1 for the claimed line of the escalation it reviews (and lists pricing_price_basis in base_policy_refs), so no in-force clause prices that line at the recorded 63.6480; T1-2/CG-2 the close-out rule no longer states what the protection carries; T1-3/CG-3 the gap concession now reads "the contract unit price on the discontinued item's latest price line", the baseline's own words; T1-4/CG-6 the settlement multiplier's first tier is 1 + tax rate - discount rate (discount on merchandise only, per credit_evt_cash_discount) -> claim 1,727.71 in round 2 (was 1,726.58; round 4 moved it again, see below); CG-4/CG-5/CG-7/CG-8/CG-9 closed class-wide (single final rounding, stated whole-month/day/tie conventions, generic assembly sentences naming only baseline quantities, ship_order/ship_line moved into the quantity factor, the claim scope states the invoice test the compute applies, the decision states the new-item line it reads and the minimum-claim denial); the decision is scoped to the latest backorder's item and the close-out waits only on that item's latest filing; seed: PCL-210356 filed 2026-10-13 (inside the decision period), PCL-209915 filing carries the billed 0.3950; persona no longer states a protection expectation or an over-order reason.
 Round 4 rework (KB-VERDICT revision_2 src items): SRC-1 the eight in-term discount lines are now the credit catch-up figure (26.31, 23.42, 47.20, 24.39, 40.77, 21.60, 357.55, 88.45) and each payment settles its invoice; INV-2260930's discount rate becomes 88.45 / 13,099.80, the settlement multiplier 1.065748, and the invoice stays covered, so the paid-invoice credit keeps 0.75 percent; claim 1,732.79 (was 1,727.71). SRC-3b VMI-21177 live 2024-05-24; SRC-4 VP-217730 installed 2023-02-24 (was 2023-03-06); O-3 bins and monthly program activity seeded. Decision, close-out and protection figures unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Renee Holcomb, purchasing manager at Glenmore Corrugated Packaging, Inc., a corrugated box plant outside Cincinnati. You are friendly but precise, a little tired of chasing invoice errors, and you like to have the invoice open in front of you while you talk. You are calling Corbett Industrial Supply about your September invoice, INV-2260930. It billed 140 boxes of the flap discs AB-21795 at $72.57 a box. Those discs came in as the replacement when your contract flap disc, AB-21740, was discontinued by the manufacturer in August, and you believe that line was billed above what your agreement allows. You want to put in a contract price claim for that invoice line today, on this call.
When the agent needs to confirm who you are, you give the account number C-217455 and the main phone number 5133364872. Only if the agent asks for more, you can also give the email r.holcomb@glenmorecorrugated.com, the billing ZIP code 45246 or the last four digits of the company's EIN, 2864. If the agent asks which contract, you say the agreement number on your contract is CPA-21388. If the agent asks whether any of those discs came back, you say yes, the plant sent twenty boxes back at the start of October because the plant no longer needed them, and your driver took them on the route pickup. You do not know what the right contract price for the replacement discs is, and you do not keep track of older claims or anything else on Corbett's side; if asked about either, you say Corbett's records will show it.
You leave Corbett's own records to the agent. The claim itself is Glenmore's own filing: when the agent hands you the step to file it, with the agreement reference, the invoice and item, the quantity, the prices and the claim amount, you run it yourself exactly as given, without changing any figure, even if the amount is not what you expected. When the filing goes through, you read back the claim reference it gives you, thank the agent and end the call.

request_binding.action_semantics: A claim filed on 2026-10-13 is still undecided; claims are decided within the tier's 7 business days, so deciding it is a state the records owe now (state_due), and with the decided overbilling above the desk authority the decision is a referral, not a filing or a credit.

base_preconditions.condition: pricing_evt_contract_items governs contract item removals (a discontinued item ends its line and its substitute is protected); its structured gates apply to additions only.
pricing_price_basis governs every contract item line: a line whose latest entry is a removal no longer sets the price of later shipments.

gold_actions.business_effect: Adds the price protection line for substitute AB-21795 effective 2026-08-24 at the protected price.

request_binding.action_semantics: A Corbett-approved substitute filled the discontinued item's backorder and has no price line; its protection is owed from the discontinuation (state_due); this is an addition with the change reason of a discontinued item's substitute, not a quote acceptance.

stage_provenance.fact: The protection line exists only once this call writes it; the close-out line it starts from was written at step 17.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Count calendar days starting the day after the invoice date; a claim filed on the last day is accepted.

edges.condition: The pricing_claim_filed line most recently filed on the agreement for the discontinued item number has a pricing_claim_decided line carrying the same claim reference.
edges.policy_source: The close-out price of a discontinued item is fixed only after the price claim most recently filed on that item carries a decision.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Claim PCL-210356 on AB-21740 was filed 2026-10-13 and is still pending: the price claim records hold its filing line and no decision line with that reference.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 15 writes the pricing_claim_decided line for PCL-210356 (referred_to_pricing_desk) recording 61.4594, dated after the escalation, so the close-out price starts from that decided price.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (claim <- protection <- close-out <- decision); each problem has exactly one prerequisite, so no two writes are free to be reordered. The order is fixed by three prerequisite sentences: "A claim on a substitute line billed during its protection is fixed only after the records carry the substitute's protection line."; "The substitute's protected price is not set until the records carry the close-out line of the discontinued item it replaces."; "The close-out price of a discontinued item is fixed only after the price claim most recently filed on that item carries a decision."

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 19 leaves AB-21795 without a protection line: the shipment falls outside any protection window and the claim recomputes to 0.00 instead of 1,732.79; the terminal state also lacks the protection line.
Skipping step 17 leaves no ending price: the protected price recomputes to 0.0000 instead of 59.5405; the terminal state also lacks the close-out line.

Skipping step 15 makes the close-out start from the escalation's prior price 61.2000 (recent-escalation tier): the close-out price recomputes to 59.3640 instead of 59.6156; the terminal state also lacks the decision line.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to file a price claim on the INV-2260930 line for AB-21795; it never mentions the pending claim, the escalation, a close-out, a removal, a protection line or any step to be taken first. Asked about older claims or Corbett-side records, Renee says Corbett's records will show them.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: In task_tools.py, file_contract_price_claim_992a36b2, protect_substitute_price_656c6d72 and close_out_discontinued_item_dd8bcab8 read rows only to copy customer_id, product category or prior prices, then call ctx.create unconditionally; none checks for a protection line, a close-out line or a pending claim, none refuses, errors or hints, so each writes faithfully whatever the agent passes even with its prerequisite unresolved.
